discovery: Controlled/living radical polymerization, in particular atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP), for precise synthesis of well-defined polymers and functional macromolecular materials
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes went to life-science and framework-materials topics (protein design and AlphaFold in 2024, MOFs in 2025), so the committee may turn to synthetic polymer chemistry. Controlled radical polymerization changed how polymers are made in industry and academia. Matyjaszewski and Sawamoto independently reported metal-catalyzed ATRP in 1995. Their work is among the most cited in chemistry, has won the Wolf Prize and other major awards, and has been a frequent Nobel prediction for years.
